compare_subtitle: Sauce-dispenser expansion of 2 Oct 2026 (34 squeeze-bottle, shaker and pump variants, AT/DE/CZ/SK/RO; see Change log).
benchmark_reason: Every squeeze bottle, shaker and pump dispenser of the Shopify Sauce Dispensers collection that was not yet in the file (colour variants collapsed). 8 benchmarks already in the file (PP single-tip bottles 250/500/750/1,000 ml, 500 ml triple tip, 750 ml wide covered tip, 2 L pump dispenser with and without stand) were not researched again.
